title: Switch on a conda environment
story: Some design tools live in conda environments: ProteinMPNN in proteinmpnn, Chai-1 in chai, RFD4-Proteina in rfd4. conda itself comes from a module. Activate the {{env}} environment.
hints: `conda` only exists after `module load anaconda`. `conda env list` shows the environments.
`module load anaconda`, then `conda activate {{env}}`. Your prompt changes to show it.
